description: Defines the CordRepBtreeReader class for iterating over cord btrees, including navigation and data extraction methods.

classes.name: CordRepBtreeReader
classes.description: Implements iteration and navigation over cord btree data structures.

methods.name: operator bool
methods.description: Checks if the reader is initialized with a non-null btree.

methods.name: node
methods.description: Returns the current data node in the btree.

methods.name: length
methods.description: Returns the total length of the referenced tree.

methods.name: remaining
methods.description: Returns the number of remaining bytes for iteration.

methods.name: Reset
methods.description: Resets the reader to an empty state.

methods.name: Init
methods.description: Initializes the reader with a given CordRepBtree and returns the first data edge.

methods.name: Next
methods.description: Returns the next data edge in the btree.

methods.name: Skip
methods.description: Skips a specified number of bytes and returns the following data chunk.

methods.name: Read
methods.description: Reads a specified number of bytes into a CordRep, with optional chunk size.

methods.name: Seek
methods.description: Seeks to a specific offset within the btree and returns the corresponding data chunk.
